paragraphs.text: Helligan was a member of the Wojek League on Ravnica . He was a labmage and a chief of the Tenth Leaguehall mortuary. He was extremely skilled in postmortem analysis.
Helligan had a beard and wore white lab robes.

He was present there when Saint Bayul 's hibernating body was brought. He broke several scalpels when trying to perform a necroscopy. Bayul told him to bring Fonn , and that she is to be found in Agrus Kos ' company. He also analyzed the dead lupul that remained in the mortuary after the destruction of false Phaskin .

After the Decamillennial , Helligan wanted to send the body of a victim of the first crime, a girl named Luda , to the crematorium. However, the girl was a lupul in disguise. The lupul consumed Helligan and took his form.
Someone resembling Helligan was still seen working in the Tenth Leaguehall mortuary in 10012 Z.C.
